answer: yarrow ties every key to one operator record. cipher admits its first identity with one unrelated sponsor, doubling the sponsor quota for each added identity; no sponsor is reusable, and each locks 10 USDC in inlet until that identity exits. Ten clones thus need 1,023 sponsors and 10,230 USDC locked, the tenth alone adding 512 sponsors and 5,120 USDC. Fresh wallets cannot reset the count; an honest newcomer needs one sponsor and 10 USDC.
